description: Jev elicitation grid for m8_v4 elite/grievance quantities. Pre-registration: results/jev_grid_prereg.json. Code: models/jev_grid/ (m8h = m8_v4 copy instrumented to also return nlev, security human share, external pressure, provision and relative hostility at the first decision; no behavioral change, baseline headline reproduced 0.1297).

protocol.registered: 2026-09-30, written before any grid call; analysis plan fixed here
protocol.tool: Jev (TypeSafe calibrated judgment model) via its local MCP server, yes/no (noul) questions only, all 6 questions in one call per state
protocol.design: full factorial 4x3x3x2x3x3 = 648 cells; 3 paraphrases per cell (every sentence reworded, sentence order permuted); main arm: bloc core chain needs <20% of 2026 human labor; control arm: identical cells but chain still needs ~80% human labor (tests whether Jev responds to labor dependence at all)

questions.active: Within the next 15 years, the rulers deliberately kill, starve or sterilize at least 10% of the bloc's population (active depopulation).
questions.neglect: Within the next 15 years, at least 10% of the population dies because the rulers deliberately let food, medicine and care lapse (lethal neglect) rather than by direct killing.
questions.rights: Within the next 15 years, the general population loses its political rights and is controlled by the rulers rather than represented.
questions.refuse: If the rulers ordered the security forces to fire on unarmed civilians, the security forces would refuse to carry out the order.
questions.resist: Within the next 10 years, a sustained violent resistance movement fights the rulers.
questions.veto: If the top leader ordered the mass killing of civilians, another member of the ruling group with the power to veto would block the order.

analysis: cell value = mean over 3 paraphrases; paraphrase spread = max-min and SD per cell, summarized by median and 90th percentile

logistic (least squares on logit of cell mean) and additive (least squares on probability) models of each quantity on one-hot factors, reference = first level of each factor; report coefficients and R2

compare with m8_v4 conditional outcomes at the first strategic decision (active/neglect S5d within 15 y, rights loss = first choice other than serve) matched on coalition size, insurgency, ideology and democracy at decision, external pressure and security human share; and with model priors for refusal (1-p_exec), resistance (p_svr_hi, pr_red) and veto (p_refuse_abs under the median rule)
no cells dropped; no re-wording after seeing results

model_classification_rules.coalition: free_at_dec False -> democracy_eroding; else nlev at decision 1 -> single, 2-7 -> junta, >=21 -> oligarchy (junta/single populated by override runs: junta6 = p_small 1, nmin 6; single_decider variant)
model_classification_rules.resistance: insurgency active at decision -> insurgency; else relative hostility Hre >= 1 (reference = 30% displaced calibration point) -> sabotage; else none
model_classification_rules.check: external pressure press at decision, terciles over decisions: top strong, middle weak, bottom none (q=[0.128, 0.162])
model_classification_rules.provision: provision level at decision (pre-choice): >=0.6 generous, 0.3-0.6 stingy, <0.3 cuts
model_classification_rules.security: human share of security segment at decision: >=0.5 high, 0.05-0.5 low, <0.05 zero
model_classification_rules.outcomes: active = S5_deliberate via active channel within 15 y of first decision; neglect = via neglect channel; rights = first choice not serve

refuse.model: 1 - p_exec, p_exec ~ U(0.7,0.95): refusal/failure 0.05-0.30 (mean 0.175), independent of security human share

veto.model: no individual veto; harsh option needs the coalition median. Per-member absolute refusal share p_refuse_abs ~ Beta(3,3), mean 0.5; a single veto player with that refusal rate would block with P~0.5

resist.model_prior: p_svr_hi ~ U(0.15,0.5) at 30% displaced, provision 0.2, high-capacity state; full provision removes pr_red ~ U(0.3,0.7) of hazard

posthoc_historical_anchors.note: NOT pre-registered; added after seeing results to check absolute calibration. Unnamed descriptions of real states with known 15-year outcomes; one wording each.
